# Qwen3.8-27B AlphaDflash MTP head (GGUF sidecar)

A retrained **multi-token-prediction (MTP) draft head for Qwen3.8-27B**, for **AlphaLlama 2.0.10 and later**. It
replaces the draft head inside your Qwen3.8-27B GGUF at load time; the model file itself stays unchanged. Drafts are
always verified by the full model, so the head changes speed only, not what the model can answer.

## What it is

- **The file:** the 15 tensors of the model's MTP block (`blk.64.*`), 351 MB, in the same tensor types as
  `Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf`. AlphaLlama loads them in place of that file's own `blk.64.*`.
- **What AlphaChat changed:** the MTP block was retrained (fine-tuned) by AlphaChat on text generated by Qwen3.8-27B
  itself, so its drafts match the model's own next tokens more often. The rest of the model is untouched. The training
  text is mostly English; prompts in other languages gain less.
- **Base model:** [`Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B), Apache-2.0. Tested with
  `Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf` from [`unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF`](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF).
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, as the base model. See `LICENSE`.

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `alphadflash-27b-head.gguf` | 351,009,888 bytes (351 MB) | `33e6a004d0fe9eff4fab5f6b58001c2415887c21f7167939b796f06dfa814350` |

## Use with AlphaLlama

**Requirements:** Qwen3.8-27B (`Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf`), AlphaLlama 2.0.10 or later with an NVIDIA GPU.

1. Put the file in one of these places:
   - **beside the model:** `<folder of your 27B .gguf>/alphadflash-27b-head.gguf`, or
   - **in a sibling folder:** `<parent folder>/Qwen3.8-27B-AlphaDflash/alphadflash-27b-head.gguf`, or
   - **anywhere,** then point to it with `ALPHA_AI_MTP_HEAD=/path/to/alphadflash-27b-head.gguf`.
2. Start as usual:
   ```
   alphallama-serve -m Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf
   ```
3. Check that it is active. The startup log shows:
   ```
   [auto] MTP head: AlphaDflash 27B MTP head <path>, depth 7
   [ai] MTP head sidecar <path>: 15 tensors (334.8 MiB) replace the model's
   ```
   If the file isn't found, the server says so and uses the model's own head.

On an RTX 3090 or 5090, default (fast) decoding then drafts 7 tokens deep at 2 x 98,304 context instead of 3 deep at
2 x 131,072. Pass `-c` to choose the context yourself. On cards where AlphaLlama uses its own tuned drafting (16-20 GB
cards), the head is loaded but that tuning is kept.

## Quality and speed

**Quality** (RTX 3090, temperature 0, thinking off; paired against plain decoding of the same model, same prompts):

| Benchmark | Plain decoding | With this head, 7 deep |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K (CoT, flexible extract) | 96.06% | 95.91% (-0.15 pt, 95% CI -0.75 to +0.44) |
| MMLU (generative) | 83.79% | 83.79% |
| CMMLU (generative) | 81.34% | 81.34% |
| HumanEval | 156 / 164 | 158 / 164 |

`--decode-mode exact` with this head gives text identical to plain decoding (25 / 25 prompts).

**Speed** (RTX 3090, AlphaLlama 2.0.10 candidate, board sets A / V / R, 25 prompts x 2 passes, decode tok/s,
geomean per set):

| | A | V | R |
|---|---|---|---|
| Default fast mode, the model's own head | 104.2 | 109.6 | 122.2 |
| Default fast mode, this head | 124.8 | 147.2 | 195.3 |
| Gain | +20% | +34% | +60% |

Speed mode (`ALPHA_SPEED_MODE=1`, with the DFlash2 drafter) is unchanged by this head (within 1%).
